query: I adopted the cutest little tabby kitten from the shelter yesterday, she’s already figured out how to knock my mug off the coffee table when she wants attention. I’ve also been trying out this new sourdough recipe and I finally got a loaf with a properly crispy crust this morning, it tasted amazing with some homemade strawberry jam. Oh, and I’ve been binging this new fantasy drama series, the plot twists have kept me up way too late the past three nights. Anyway, I’m having an issue with my mobile service right now – my network connection is really bad, my SMS app permissions seem to be broken, mobile data is turned off, I’ve already exceeded my monthly data usage limit, and I’m currently abroad with roaming disabled so nothing’s working properly, I need help fixing this.
